Iris (FinOps): Flagging a weird set of invoices in today's reconciliation: 36 invoices have duplicated usage lines and the tax codes in NetSuite show USD rates even though the customers are EUR. NetSuite posting for 2026-04-05 03:00 UTC looks contaminated.

Omar (Payments Eng): Do we have invoice IDs/examples? Might be a mapping or currency normalization bug in the NS export.

Iris (FinOps): Sample inv IDs: inv_04Lx7P2A, inv_04Lx8T9B. Customers cus_EU_77 and cus_EU_94. Export row snippet from NS CSV: 
```
inv_04Lx7P2A, cus_EU_77, line_1, usage, 100, USD, tax_code=TX001
inv_04Lx7P2A, cus_EU_77, line_1, usage, 100, USD, tax_code=TX001
```
Lines duplicated and currency column USD while Stripe shows EUR.

ns-sync-bot: NOTICE: netsuite-export job finished with warnings: currency_mismatch=36, duplicate_line_detected=36 at 2026-04-05T03:05:12Z. Job ID ns-export-2026-04-05-03.

Jules (Billing Ops): I paused the NetSuite import queue at 03:10 UTC. Do not re-run import until we confirm remediation. Also marking affected invoices as "pending_review" in the ledger.

Omar (Payments Eng): Quick hypothesis: the export transformer normalizes currencies using a stale exchange table when source invoice.metadata.locale=eu triggers a fallback path. That path also had an earlier bug that concatenated usage batch rows when the batch key was empty, producing duplicates. Both bugs shipped in the same platform release 2026-04-04T22:00 (payments/exporter v3.1.0).

I will revert the exporter to v3.0.8 for the next run and open a patch (payments/exporter#481) to fix the batch-key generation and currency mapping. ETA revert <30m.

Iris (FinOps): For remediation we need: (1) a cleaned NetSuite CSV without duplicates and correct currency/tax codes, (2) a re-import plan that is idempotent or will skip invoices already posted, (3) a reconciliation of any rounding deltas created. Please also surface which customers may have received incorrect PDF invoices.

Jules (Billing Ops): I'll generate a corrected export by deduping lines and re-mapping currency using our canonical Stripe invoice object. Running script: 
```bash
python tools/ns_clean_export.py --source gs://redwood-finance/exports/ns-export-2026-04-05-03.csv \
  --dedupe-by invoice_id,line_hash --repair-currency-from stripe --out gs://redwood-finance/backfills/ns-clean-2026-04-05-03.csv
```
I'll validate checksums and share a manifest before any re-import.

Omar (Payments Eng): Revert applied to exporter; new run scheduled. Also adding alerts: netsuite.currency_mismatch and netsuite.duplicate_lines to catch this earlier. Patch PR opened to fix mapping and batch key generation.

ns-sync-bot: Incident INC-2026-3502 created: severity=medium, assignee=Omar (Payments Eng). Duplicate rows detected=36, affected_invoices=36.

Iris (FinOps): Good catch. Please keep accounting and CS in the loop. If any invoices had payments applied, we'll need manual adjustment. Jules, flag invoices with payment_status!=open for manual review.

Jules (Billing Ops): Flagged 9 invoices with payment_status=paid for manual review and added comments for AR. Preparing a reconciliation run after the repaired import.

Omar (Payments Eng): Postmortem owner: me. Immediate actions: revert exporter, run cleaned export, add verification step to fail export if currency != stripe_currency, and add unit test for batch key edgecases.

Iris (FinOps): Thanks. Once the cleaned import is complete, I'll run revenue reconciliation and confirm no double-posts. Keep updates here.
